verdict.rationale: Obsidian stores notes as local plain-text Markdown files in a vault the user fully owns, explicitly designed to work offline and remain readable/editable outside the app, with community testimonials confirming file-based ownership and offline reliability (obsidian-docs-2, obsidian-docs-20, obsidian-docs-23, obsidian-comm-3, obsidian-comm-20). missing for 10: independent long-term audit of full offline functionality across all core+community plugins, and one noted exception (Canvas using JSON rather than Markdown) that slightly muddies the 'plain text' guarantee.
